MINION_LIB_CARD_SUMMON_ATTACKAKA_CARD.de: [gold]Summon[/gold] an Attackaka with {Summon:diff()} HP. Give it {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold]. It can strike once per turn. At the start of your turn, it adds 1 [gold]Attackaka Strike[/gold] to your hand.
MINION_LIB_CARD_SUMMON_DEFENSEAKA_CARD.d: [gold]Summon[/gold] a Defenseaka with {Summon:diff()} HP. Give it {DexterityPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold] and [gold]Guardian[/gold]. It can block once per turn.
MINION_LIB_CARD_ATTACKAKA_STRIKE_CARD.de: Make the bound minion [gold]{BoundMinionName}[/gold] deal {BoundPetDamage:diff()} damage to an enemy.
MINION_LIB_CARD_DEFENSEAKA_GUARD_CARD.de: Gain {BoundPetBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] from the bound minion [gold]{BoundMinionName}[/gold], based on its [gold]Dexterity[/gold] and [gold]Strength[/gold].
